subject.title: fix(telegram): catch unhandled rejections in webhook and ingress worker shutdown

question: Should Telegram webhook shutdown remain non-rejecting when an owned server, bot, or transport fails to close?
rationale: The patch is internally consistent, but swallowing cleanup failures changes what callers can observe and may report shutdown complete while a resource remains active.

options.title: Accept fail-soft shutdown
options.body: Continue all cleanup phases, log individual failures, and resolve shutdown so abort listeners cannot leak rejected promises.

options.title: Preserve failure signaling
options.body: Continue later cleanup but return an aggregate failure to callers that explicitly await shutdown, while fire-and-forget listeners observe it safely.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-soft shutdown
recommendation.body: Continue all cleanup phases, log individual failures, and resolve shutdown so abort listeners cannot leak rejected promises.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history directly connects this person to Telegram ingress-worker lifecycle behavior affected by the decision.
